# Muse Web Studio

Muse Web Studio is a one-woman creative web studio founded by Naima and based in Hargeisa, Somaliland. Muse works remotely with small businesses, startups and personal brands worldwide.

## What Muse does
- Custom website design and development
- Small business website design
- Website redesigns and refreshes
- Website fixes and performance improvements
- Landing pages and conversion-focused websites
- Logo and brand identity design
- Responsive mobile-first web design
- SEO-ready website structure

## Positioning
Muse is a direct-to-client, one-person web design studio: clients work with the designer/developer directly rather than a large agency team. The studio focuses on considered, editorial web design, responsive builds, clear structure and practical SEO foundations.

## International service areas
Muse serves clients remotely in the United States, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Canada, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, Singapore, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Netherlands, Germany and Switzerland, as well as worldwide.
